scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
I'm afraid there's something wrong with our old cemetery...
But thanks to you, {0}, we'll be able to sleep {1} nights!
But thanks to {2}'s support, we've got {3} easy nights!
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
恐怕舊墓地出了點問題...
但多虧了你，{0}，我們能安睡{1}個夜晚了！
但多虧了{2}的幫助，我們能安睡{3}個夜晚了！

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
I'm afraid there's something wrong with our old cemetery...
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
恐怕舊墓地出了點問題...

scripts.text:
THEY could return tomorrow's night again!
Thank you, {0}! Now we'll manage to rest till the next midnight!
But due to {1}'s help we'll manage to rest till the next midnight!
To calm down the restless cemetery, we should pour all these graves with the Holy Water. But our sisters and brothers have run out of it.
Could you supply us with Holy Water?
scripts.translation:
它們可能明天晚上又會回來！
謝謝你，{0}！現在我們能休息到明晚午夜了！
但多虧了{1}的幫助，我們能休息到明晚午夜了！
要讓墓地恢復安寧，得在每座墳墓上灑聖水。
可修士和修女們的聖水已經用完了。
你能給我們送些聖水嗎？

scripts.text:
To calm down the restless cemetery, we should pour all these graves with the Holy Water. But our sisters and brothers have run out of it.
Could you supply us with Holy Water?
scripts.translation:
要讓墓地恢復安寧，得在每座墳墓上灑聖水。
可修士和修女們的聖水已經用完了。
你能給我們送些聖水嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, have all my Holy Water!
scripts.translation: 好，把我的聖水全給你們

scripts.text: Nope, I need it.
scripts.translation: 不行，我還要用

scripts.text: I don't have any.
scripts.translation: 我沒有

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
Thank you, {0}! Now we've got enough Holy Water!
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
謝謝您，{0}！現在我們有足夠的聖水了！

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
Upon pouring the cemetery with that water we'll get {0} safe nights!
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
用這些聖水灑過墓地，我們就能平安度過 {0} 個夜晚！

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
See, {0}? They all are gone now!
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
看，{0}，它們全都消失了！

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
Our Church is going to thank you personally...
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
教會將親自向你致謝...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
In the name of Odin we bless you and decently present a modest gift just from Mareusis' wine-cellar.
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
以奧丁之名，我們為您祈福，並奉上來自瑪雷烏斯酒窖的一點薄禮。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
Thank you, good {0}, but we still need {1} more Holy Water bottles.
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
謝謝你，善良的 {0}，不過還差 {1} 瓶聖水。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
I'm afraid the old cemetery is going out of control soon... Please, get us all the Holy Water you can get.
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
恐怕舊墓地很快就要失控了... 請儘可能多地為我們收集聖水。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathana]
Alas! We still need {0} more bottles of Holy Water...  Why don't you go and ask other people for some extra Holy Water?
The old cemetery is going out of control soon...
Please, in the name of Odin, help Prontera city.
scripts.translation:
[瑪薩娜修女]
唉！還差 {0} 瓶聖水...
去問問其他人，看看能不能再湊一些吧？
舊墓地馬上就要失控了...
以奧丁之名，請幫幫普隆德拉城吧。
